title: Dual-Runtime Plugin Interface Architecture (Effect & Promise)
context: Plugin authoring SDKs bridging functional effect systems and mainstream async/await developer interfaces.
distilled_learning: Providing both monadic effect layers and standard async/await promise facades eliminates plugin developer friction while preserving cancellation tokens and fiber concurrency in the internal kernel.

claims.assertion: Providing both monadic effect layers and standard async/await promise facades eliminates plugin developer friction while preserving cancellation tokens and fiber concurrency in the internal kernel.
